svg.title: Crunch migration HUD replay and packaged Loading-map fix
svg.desc: Before and after flow showing the packaged Loading map being cooked and the HUD replaying authoritative role state after a late Web UI connection.
svg.text: Crunch migration: close the package/HUD startup blockers
2026-09-04 implementation and validation archive
Observed failure
Cook/stage command omitted Loading.umap
→ travel from Login could not resolve /Game/Maps/Loading
Late CEF/Web UI handshake left the HUD on
“Loading role” / “Profile session initializing…”
RoleState could arrive on PlayerState before pawn application.
Applied fix
BuildCookRun explicitly cooks Login + Loading + StartupMap
and archives both Loading.umap and Loading.uexp.
On first Web UI connection, clear replay caches and
send the complete authoritative HUD snapshot.
DisplayRoleId prefers applied pawn state, then PlayerState.
Validation evidence
✓ Aura Win64 Development build: exit 0
✓ Fresh Win64 Game BuildCookRun: BUILD SUCCESSFUL, exit 0
✓ Manifest_UFSFiles_Win64.txt contains Loading.umap + Loading.uexp
✓ HUDContract automation: Success; Crunch migration automation: 7/7 Success
✓ Movement-preserving listen reports: semantic timeline validator PASS (2 latest reports)
Visual caveat: rebuilt Aura.exe triggered Windows Firewall permission UI; no security setting was changed.
